adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` (see `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`). If the id is unknown, `host` will be `nil`, leading to a `NoMethodError` (e.g., `host.host = ...` in `save_host`) and a 500 instead of a 404/not-found response.
